votes.sql:
SELECT e.event_name,
       e.event_date,
       COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) AS total_attendees,
       COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget_amount,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) >= 100 OR COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) >= 1000 THEN 'High Priority'
           WHEN COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) >= 20  OR COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) >= 200  THEN 'Medium Priority'
           ELSE 'Low Priority'
       END AS priority_level
FROM "event" e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event;

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COALESCE(att.attendee_count, 0) AS total_attendees,
    COALESCE(bud.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget,
    CASE 
        WHEN e.type = 'Election' THEN 'High Priority'
        WHEN e.type = 'Meeting' THEN 'Medium Priority'
        ELSE 'Low Priority'
    END AS priority_level
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) att ON e.event_id = att.link_to_event
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) bud ON e.event_id = bud.link_to_event

WITH event_att AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date,
           COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS total_attendees
    FROM "event" e
    LEFT JOIN "attendance" a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date
),
-- Sum budget amount per event
event_budget AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event,
           SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
    FROM "budget" b
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT ea.event_name,
       ea.event_date,
       ea.total_attendees,
       COALESCE(eb.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget,
       CASE e.status
           WHEN 'Open' THEN 'High Priority'
           WHEN 'Planning' THEN 'Medium Priority'
           WHEN 'Closed' THEN 'Low Priority'
           ELSE 'Unknown'
       END AS priority_level
FROM event_att ea
JOIN "event" e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN event_budget eb ON ea.event_id = eb.link_to_event
ORDER BY ea.event_name;

votes.sql:
SELECT (m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name) AS full_name,
       ma.college,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS closed_event_count
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
               AND e.status = 'Closed'
               AND substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) IN ('2019', '2020')
WHERE m.financial_risk_score > 80
GROUP BY m.member_id
ORDER BY m.financial_risk_score DESC;

}SELECT 
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    maj.college,
    COUNT(e.event_id) AS closed_events_count
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
JOIN attendance att ON m.member_id = att.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON att.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) IN ('2019', '2020')
GROUP BY m.member_id
ORDER BY closed_events_count DESC

SELECT (m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name) AS full_name, mj.college AS college, COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS total_closed_events
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN "attendance" a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN "event" e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) IN ('2019', '2020')
  AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY m.member_id
ORDER BY total_closed_events DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH event_spent AS (
    SELECT e.event_name,
           SUM(b.spent) AS total_usd
    FROM "event" e
    JOIN "budget" b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
    HAVING total_usd > 1000
)
SELECT event_name,
       ROUND(total_usd * 0.92, 2) AS total_eur
FROM event_spent;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) * 0.85 AS amount_in_euros
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(b.spent) > 1000

SELECT "e"."event_name", SUM(COALESCE("b"."spent", 0)) * 0.92 AS total_spent_eur FROM "event" AS "e" JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e"."event_id" = "b"."link_to_event" GROUP BY "e"."event_id", "e"."event_name" HAVING SUM(COALESCE("b"."spent", 0)) > 1000;

votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM "member" AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "attendance" AS a
    JOIN "event" AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE a.link_to_member = m.member_id
      AND date(substr(e.event_date, 1, 10)) >= date('now', '-1 year')
);

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE DATE(e.event_date) >= DATE('now', '-1 year')

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE date(e.event_date) >= date((SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM event), '-1 year')
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name;

SELECT e.event_name,
       SUM(b.amount) * 0.85 AS total_budget_eur
FROM "event" e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) > 30;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_euros FROM event e INNER JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event INNER JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) > 30;

WITH event_attendance AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
event_budget AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_usd
    FROM budget b
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT e.event_name,
       (eb.total_budget_usd * 0.85) AS total_budget_euros
FROM event e
JOIN event_attendance ea ON e.event_id = ea.event_id
JOIN event_budget eb ON e.event_id = eb.link_to_event
WHERE ea.attendee_count > 30;

SELECT (m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name) AS person,
       COUNT(a.link_to_event) *
       CASE
           WHEN m.position = 'Officer' THEN 2
           WHEN m.position = 'Board Member' THEN 3
           ELSE 1
       END AS influence
FROM "member" m
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, m.position
ORDER BY influence DESC;

FROM "expense" e
JOIN "budget" b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN "event" ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
GROUP BY ev.event_id;

SELECT 
    e.event_name,
    ROUND(SUM(b.remaining) * 0.79, 2) AS remaining_british_pounds
FROM "budget" b
JOIN "event" e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name

WITH event_remaining AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id,
           SUM(b.remaining) AS total_remaining_usd
    FROM budget b
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT (er.total_remaining_usd * 0.75) AS remaining_gbp
FROM event_remaining er
WHERE (er.total_remaining_usd * 0.75) > 200;

votes.sql:
SELECT m.member_id,
       COALESCE(es.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent,
       maj.department
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id,
           SUM(e.cost) AS total_spent
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE LOWER(ev.notes) LIKE '%high-risk%'
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
) es ON es.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN event ev2 ON ev2.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE a.link_to_member = m.member_id
      AND LOWER(ev2.notes) LIKE '%high-risk%'
);

WITH high_risk_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event
    FROM budget b
    WHERE b.remaining < 0
),
members_with_attendance AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT att.link_to_member
    FROM attendance att
    INNER JOIN high_risk_events hre ON att.link_to_event = hre.link_to_event
)
SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    maj.department,
    SUM(e.cost) AS total_spent
FROM member m
INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
INNER JOIN members_with_attendance mwa ON m.member_id = mwa.link_to_member
INNER JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
INNER JOIN budget b_exp ON e.link_to_budget = b_exp.budget_id
INNER JOIN high_risk_events hre ON b_exp.link_to_event = hre.link_to_event
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, maj.department
ORDER BY m.member_id

WITH high_risk_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id
  FROM budget
  WHERE remaining < 0
),
member_attended AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.link_to_member AS member_id
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN high_risk_events h ON a.link_to_event = h.event_id
),
member_expenses AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id,
         SUM(e.cost) AS total_spent
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  JOIN high_risk_events h ON b.link_to_event = h.event_id
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member
)
SELECT m.member_id,
       COALESCE(me.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent,
       mj.department
FROM member m
JOIN member_attended ma ON m.member_id = ma.member_id
LEFT JOIN member_expenses me ON m.member_id = me.member_id
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id;

votes.sql:
WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT e.event_id,
           e.event_name,
           COALESCE(b.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent,
           COALESCE(b.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
           COALESCE(a.attendance_count, 0) AS attendance_count,
           COALESCE(ex.approval_rate, 0) AS approval_rate
    FROM "event" e
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT link_to_event,
               SUM(spent)   AS total_spent,
               SUM(amount) AS total_amount
        FROM budget
        GROUP BY link_to_event
    ) b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT link_to_event,
               COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendance_count
        FROM attendance
        GROUP BY link_to_event
    ) a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT b.link_to_event,
               AVG(CASE WHEN ex.approved = 'true' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS approval_rate
        FROM expense ex
        JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
        GROUP BY b.link_to_event
    ) ex ON ex.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
scores AS (
    SELECT event_name,
           (CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN total_spent / total_amount ELSE 0 END) *
           attendance_count *
           approval_rate AS efficiency_score
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT event_name
FROM scores
WHERE efficiency_score = (SELECT MAX(efficiency_score) FROM scores);

WITH
event_budget AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent,
        SUM(b.amount) AS total_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(b.amount) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount)
        END AS budget_utilization
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
event_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
event_expense AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        COUNT(exp.expense_id) AS total_expenses,
        SUM(CASE WHEN exp.approved = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_expenses,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(exp.expense_id) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN exp.approved = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(exp.expense_id)
        END AS approval_rate
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN expense exp ON exp.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
attendance_max AS (
    SELECT MAX(attendance_count) AS max_attendance
    FROM event_attendance
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COALESCE(b.budget_utilization, 0) AS budget_utilization,
        COALESCE(att.attendance_count, 0) AS attendance_count,
        COALESCE(exp.approval_rate, 0) AS approval_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN am.max_attendance = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(att.attendance_count, 0) * 1.0 / am.max_attendance
        END AS attendance_norm
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN event_budget b ON b.event_id = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN event_attendance att ON att.event_id = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN event_expense exp ON exp.event_id = e.event_id
    CROSS JOIN attendance_max am
)
SELECT
    event_name,
    ROUND((budget_utilization + attendance_norm + approval_rate) / 3.0, 3) AS operational_efficiency_score
FROM combined
WHERE ((budget_utilization + attendance_norm + approval_rate) / 3.0) > 0.8
ORDER BY operational_efficiency_score DESC;
